statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess efficacy of current rate-control management
